provenance.taiwan_artifact_note: The live extraction produced and uploaded six files successfully; the job failed only afterward while building the manifest because scoring.candidate_components was absent from the Taiwan config.

taiwan_extraction.source_guard_note: albescens and pengii matched GBIF only at a higher rank; fukienense did not contribute a final usable occurrence set.

primary_min_n_10.interpretation: BIO15 is a topology-stable borderline present-day association; BIO1 is a weaker negative candidate. No axis is declared significant under the frozen min_n=10 primary screen.

sensitivity_min_n_9.status: threshold sensitivity only; does not replace the primary gate
sensitivity_min_n_9.interpretation: Adding the two n=9 Taiwan taxa strengthens rather than erases the lower-BIO1 / higher-BIO15 D-state pattern, showing that the primary BIO15 candidate is not caused by excluding those sparse taxa. This remains a present-day threshold sensitivity, not historical or adaptive evidence.

next_data_priority.reason: Each is only one independent thinned environment-complete occurrence below the frozen n>=10 primary inclusion gate.
next_data_priority.do_not_do: Do not lower the frozen primary threshold merely to obtain significance.

claim_boundary: All results are present-day taxon niche-centroid associations under Brownian phylogenetic covariance. They do not establish ancestral niche states, parallel adaptation, ecological-event causation, or trait fitness effects.
